tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /legs bshad dpyod ldan yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs// buddha ratna nirm+ma ṇa/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ ston pa 'das nas mi lo sum stong dang / /drug tu slebs pa chu mo glang gi lo/ /dkon mchog rgyal po bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya btab/ /btab nas me pho 'brug lo 'di yan la/ /brgya phrag lnga dang bzhi bcu rtsa lnga lon/ /'gro mgon gshegs nas sum stong bzhi brgya dang / /nyag gcig slebs pa sa pho 'brug lo la/ /sa skya'i lha khang chen mor grags 'di byon/ /de tshe chos rgyal 'phags pa so bzhi bzhes/ /de nas sum brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu lon/ /'das pa'i lo nas sum stong lnga brgya dang / /drug bcu rtsa gnyis sa mo bya yi lo/ /ngor chen kun bzang zhe brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ /chos grwa chen po e wam̐ chos ldan btab/ /de nas brgya dang brgyad bcu rtsa brgyad lon/ /rgyal ba 'das nas sum stong lnga brgya dang / /drug bcu rtsa dgur slebs pa'i me 'brug la/ /na lend+ra byon de tshe rong ston gyi/ /dgung lo bcu phrag bdun nyid lon zhes grags/ /de nas brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig go /rnam 'dren gshegs nas sum stong lnga brgya dang / /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis sa mo sbrul gyi lo/ /byams chen rab 'byams so dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ /'bras yul skyid mos tshal byon de byon nas/ /brgya phrag gcig dang drug bcu rtsa brgyad lon/ /nyag ma gnyis dang sum stong brgya phrag drug /sangs rgyas 'das nas lon pa'i sa glang la/ /gser mdog can btab de dus paṇḍi ta/ /shākya mchog ldan zhe gnyis bzhes zhes bshad/ /de nas brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad lon/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'das nas drug brgya dang / /sum stong nyag drug chu mo sbrul gyi lo/ /kun mkhyen bsod seng zhe lnga bzhes pa'i tshe/ /thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa byon/ /byon nas brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi lon/

/chos kyi rgyal po gshegs nas nyer gnyis dang / /sum stong drug brgya lon pa'i sa bya la/ /gnyan yod bya gshong legs btab de dus su/ /'bum phrag gsum pas lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhes/ /de nas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon/ /thub bstan bya gshong btab nas nyag ma gsum/ /'das nas bzhi pa byi lo yangs can btab/ /zas gtsang sras po 'das nas sum stong dang / /lnga brgya bcur slebs buddha shrī yis/ /lnga bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pa'i me sbrul la/ /ga ya dha ras lung bstan zhe dgon byon/ /de nas brgya dang bcu phrag drug lon no/ /sgyu 'phrul sras nyid gshegs nas sum stong dang / /brgya phrag lon pa me mo sbrul lo la/ /gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon gnas byon/ /de tshe sems dpa' chen pos lnga bcu bzhes/ /de nas brgya dang bcu phrag brgyad lon zhing / /'di 'phro phyis nas rim bzhin 'chad par spro/ /tshul 'di'ang sngon byon mkhas pa yi/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho la brten nas/ /blo gros rab gsal sa skya pa/ /btsun pa ngag dbang kun bsod kyis/ /rang lo bcu phrag gnyis lon tshe/ /bris 'dis dpyod ldan kun dges shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ legs bshad dpyod ldan yid 'phrog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
